limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on test was completed.
Single curated testimonial limits user experience insight

claims.statement: Kittl offers a free forever plan with 5 projects and 200 AI tokens
Pro plan ($19/month) provides 2,000 AI tokens monthly and 10GB storage
Platform integrates AI models from ByteDance, Google, OpenAI and others
Designers report reduced asset search time and Photoshop dependency
UX/UI designers experience accelerated idea-to-design workflow
Provides vector editing and background removal tools
Offers industry-specific templates for merch, branding and social media

experienceRecords.whatHappened: Used mockups and design tools to replace asset searching and Photoshop editing
experienceRecords.result: Ideas came to life in single platform

featureTranslations.plainExplanation: Credits consumed when using AI features
featureTranslations.whoCares: Frequent AI tool users monitoring usage
featureTranslations.whenItDoesNotMatter: For manual design work without AI assistance
Abstract design projects without physical products

scoreRationale.onboarding: A free plan, templates, and ready-made mockups give new users an approachable start, supporting 8.2.
scoreRationale.product: Templates, vector tools, mockups, background removal, and several AI models offer broad quick-design help, though output quality was not independently tested, supporting 7.8.
scoreRationale.support: The packet did not provide enough direct support evidence, so a cautious 6.3 reflects that uncertainty.
scoreRationale.billing: A five-project free tier and a clearly stated $19 Pro plan offer a usable entry path, while AI token use affects the real cost, supporting 7.4.
scoreRationale.overall: Kittl is a useful fast-design tool for branded and merchandise work, but thin independent evidence and untested AI output limit the score to 7.4.

conflictsAndUnknowns: No independent verification of performance claims
